description: This source file defines the `UnknownPathException` class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter project. The exception indicates that a given path does not correspond to any known command, response, or event, and includes methods for construction via a builder, as well as JSON deserialization support.

classes.name: UnknownPathException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an error when a protocol path is unknown.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A nested static builder class for constructing instances of UnknownPathException with fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Builder instance initialized with a specific JsonPointer path.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an UnknownPathException with a specified message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an UnknownPathException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
